behavior: actual arbiter take commits Control offers
UART framing and Basic dispatch precede Control decode
old Channel4 online enables UART; closing blocks only new headers
same raw clock and synchronous active-low reset
limitations: no new independent proof or physical signoff
constraints: Native synchronous internal interface; no new wire fields.
Every nonempty Verilog code line has a Chinese semantic comment.
One clock, synchronous low reset, one state register per sequential always, no function/task.
scope: reliable ordered message-word boundary, not full DL/PHY/IP
